loops.payoff: Because you never got to finish one thing.

loops.open: Why does that hurt so much?
loops.payoff: The average worker gets interrupted about every 2 minutes, 275 times a day (Microsoft).

sources: https://www.unleash.ai/artificial-intelligence/microsoft-employees-are-interrupted-every-2-minutes-how-can-ai-help-us-re-focus-on-the-work-that-matters/ (Microsoft Work Trend Index 2025, 'Breaking Down the Infinite Workday': workers get about two minutes of uninterrupted time between meetings, emails or messages in core hours; 275 interruptions a day)

slides.text: You "did nothing" all day. *So why are you this exhausted?*
slides.sub: What's really draining you, and the fix.

slides.text: Meetings. Pings. "Quick question?" *You never finished one thing.* Why does that hurt?
The average worker gets interrupted *about every 2 minutes.* What does that do?
Every switch restarts your focus. *Your brain worked all day.* So what helps?
Staying late to "catch up." *It makes tomorrow worse.* What works instead?
Block 90 minutes. Status: "Heads down until 11. Urgent? Call me."
slides.sub: Then take a real lunch, away from your desk.
